description: Human document schemas. scripts/doc-scaffold.mjs writes the skeleton, scripts/doc-check.mjs enforces it; the readable version is docs/Playbook-Document-Schemas.md. Budgets are [TARGET, MAXIMUM] words; size follows the feature checklist (small 1-10, medium 11-30, large 31-75 active items).

developer-flow-guide.title: Developer Flow Guide

conditional.Screen / Tab flows: Subject type is UI or Mixed
conditional.Service / package / job flows: Subject type is Service/Job, Package or Mixed

developer-flow-guide.rows: Every flow row or step names a real identifier in backticks, or is marked [VERIFY], [PLANNED] or [KNOWN ISSUE]; diagrams are Mermaid flowcharts; no code listings.

business-verification-reference.title: Business Verification Reference
business-verification-reference.rows: Plain English only: no SQL, code, file paths or internal names; every data source names its portal path; a mapping table whenever sources are normalised.

db-changes.title: DB Changes
db-changes.rows: Full DDL per object; one mapping row per UI field; the ER diagram is a Mermaid erDiagram.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.rows: One service or integration per row with its registration site; the system diagram is a Mermaid flowchart.

verification-guide.title: Verification Guide
verification-guide.rows: One numbered step per action; connection profiles by name, never a connection string or secret.

powerbi-mapping.title: Power BI Mapping
powerbi-mapping.rows: One view or measure per row; business logic in plain English, no DAX.
